label: Containers pin the tool environment
subgoals: Package tool binaries and libraries in one image
Pin the image by content digest instead of a mutable tag
Cap memory and CPU per job with cgroup limits

label: Sizing a parameter sweep
subgoals: Divide jobs by machines, rounding up, to count waves
Multiply waves by job length for the wall time
Price reserved machines by wall time and on-demand machines by job time

label: Scheduling, storage and data locality
subgoals: Separate independent jobs from tightly coupled runs
Stage large inputs near the compute
Key step outputs by their inputs so a sweep can resume
